title: Lease Break Quote and Reletting Fee — Lease Term Agreement Calculation Worksheet
content:
The total quoted on a lease break agreement for a Lease Term Agreement is the reletting fee plus every concession recapture and insufficient notice charge standing on the term account against the same request, rounded half up to the cent. The reletting fee of a lease break is the term program's reletting fee rate times the term's contracted rent, rounded half up to the cent.

## Lines of the worksheet

| Line | Figure | Source |
|---|---|---|
| A | Reletting fee: the term program's reletting fee rate multiplied by the contracted rent, rounded half up to the cent | the program's reletting fee rate (lease break liability settings) and the term's contracted rent |
| B | Every concession recapture standing on the term account against the request, added together | term charges tied to the open lease-break request |
| C | Every insufficient notice charge standing on the term account against the request, added together | term charges tied to the open lease-break request |
| Total | A plus B plus C, rounded half up to the cent | — |

The request is the open lease-break request of the term (the most recently submitted lease-break request). A charge standing against another request, or not tied to a request, is not part of the total.

**Rounding half up.** An amount reaching half a cent, or falling short of half a cent by no more than 0.0001 cents, is rounded up to the next cent; any other amount is rounded down.

## Worked quote (hypothetical)

Standard Lease (10-12 Months) term, reletting fee rate 0.85, contracted rent 2,015.50 dollars; against the open request the term account carries a concession recapture of 500.00 dollars and an insufficient notice charge of 900.00 dollars.

- Line A: 0.85 multiplied by 2,015.50 is 1,713.175, rounded half up to 1,713.18.
- Line B: 500.00. Line C: 900.00.
- Total quoted: 3,113.18 dollars; the reletting fee written on the agreement is 1,713.18 dollars.
